thread:
samir: Noticing a burst of fncall validator rejects hitting our routing policies for route 'answer-bot' in eu-central around 07:21 UTC. Customers see tool errors and unexpected chargebacks.

anya: Any recent changes to schema or rollout?

deploy-bot: rollout.change: user=automation promoted validator-v5 region=eu-central percent=30 -> 07:18:02 UTC

samir: Metrics snippet:
```
validator.rejects{route=\"answer-bot\",region=\"eu-central\"} = 420 (5m)
fallback.count{route=\"answer-bot\",variant=\"small-model\"} = 390 (5m)
quota.bump{acct=acct-55} = +6% (tokens)
```

ops: Who promoted v5 to 30%? That was supposed to be 10% canary. We'll check CI triggers.

anya: Immediate mitigation: flip route to permissive for eu-central and collect top-20 sample rejects. Also add metric tags: reject_reason and validator_sha.

console-lee: UX request: expose a route-level "validator mode" pill (enforce|observe|permissive) and a small "replay example" modal for support to paste responses. Add audit link for who changed the mode.

samir: I'll run `redwoodctl validators set --route answer-bot --region eu-central --policy permissive --note "emergency permissive"` and attach sample payloads.

deploy-bot: validators.update: route=answer-bot region=eu-central policy=permissive requested_by=samir 07:28:45 UTC

ops: Infra ticket INF-10150 filed to audit automatic promotions and add a human approval gate for >10% in prod regions.

anya: Follow-ups: add new metric panels for reject_rate (rejects/requests), reject_by_reason, and tokens_wasted_by_fallback; add alert: page when hard_reject_rate > 0.1 for 3m.

samir: Filing INF-10151 (metrics + alerts) and INF-10152 (console: mode pill + audit). Assigning INF-10151 -> anya, INF-10152 -> console-lee.

anya: Also propose a soft-reject path that returns the tool output with `x-redwood-validation: warning` header and emits a metric. Lowers customer impact while keeping signal.

samir: Agreed. We'll prototype soft-reject as an interim engineering pattern.

console-lee: Will mock the pill and audit flow today behind a feature flag.

samir: Thanks all. We'll follow up with a short incident note if customers report billing impact.
